title: SkyGuard Shared Terminology & Design Token Contract
description: Single source of truth for severity scales, sensor channels, anomaly archetypes, glyphs, and color tokens shared across UI, CLI, and Backend.

info.label: Info
info.description: Nominal observation or sub-threshold advisory; shown only in forensic detail views.

low.label: Low
low.description: Minor statistical deviation above dynamic threshold.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Notable anomaly requiring routine operator inspection.

high.label: High
high.description: High-confidence sensor failure or severe calibration loss.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Critical sensor outage, hardware dropout, or physical impossibility; triggers visual & audio alerts.

spike.label: Spike
spike.description: Sudden transient pulse in sensor reading exceeding multi-scale rolling MAD.

stuck.label: Stuck Value
stuck.description: Frozen constant reading over consecutive 10-minute intervals (zero variance).

drift.label: Calibration Drift
drift.description: Systematic slow divergence from physical climatological expectation and neighboring stations.

dropout.label: Signal Dropout
dropout.description: Zeroed out or null telemetry reading indicating loss of telemetry acquisition.

out_of_range.label: Out of Range
out_of_range.description: Sensor value violates physical atmospheric bounds (e.g. negative solar radiation or >100% RH).

multivariate.label: Multivariate Inconsistency
multivariate.description: Violation of cross-sensor thermodynamic laws (e.g. high solar radiation at night or dew point > temp).

ok.label: Operational
ok.description: Station sensors healthy; <2 minor anomalies in last 24h.

warning.label: Warning
warning.description: Elevated anomaly density; intermittent sensor faults detected.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Active critical sensor failure or dropout requiring technician intervention.

keyboard_shortcuts.j: Move focus down to next incident
keyboard_shortcuts.k: Move focus up to previous incident
keyboard_shortcuts.enter: Open detail drawer for selected incident
keyboard_shortcuts.f: Focus & fly camera to active station on globe
